title: Rerun failed CI jobs through their item
when: Transient infrastructure failure on the item's current PR head
need: The work claim holder reruns failed jobs through the item. Project authority comes from the stored item across all function families; a project hint cannot change it. The run must match the current PR head and be newest for its workflow. Intent and outcome persist in the item's Progress Log; a stale or superseded identity names what to inspect.
surface: Verification rules, registered rerun help and dispatch permission boundary
review: Dispatch regression and registry-wide item-target permission tests fail before the fix and pass on candidate source; deployed proof remains pending.
